<RuleLanguageLinks current="json" languages={[{"id":"json","label":"JSON (and super languages)","href":"/assist/actions/use-sorted-keys/json/"},{"id":"javascript","label":"JavaScript (and super languages)","href":"/assist/actions/use-sorted-keys/javascript/"}]} />

## Summary
- Rule available since: `v1.9.0`
- Diagnostic Category: [`assist/source/useSortedKeys`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`json/sort-keys`](https://github.com/eslint/json/blob/main/docs/rules/sort-keys.md)

## How to enable in your editor
<EditorAction includeFixAll action="source.action.useSortedKeys.biome" />
## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"assist": {
		"actions": {
			"source": {
				"useSortedKeys": "on"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Sort keys in a JSON object.

:::note
For `package.json`, use
[useSortedPackageJson](https://biomejs.dev/assist/actions/use-sorted-package-json), which
follows package-specific conventions.
:::

By default, the action uses
[natural order](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natural_sort_order): uppercase letters come
before lowercase letters (`A` before `a`), and numbers are compared by value (`item9`
before `item10`).

## Examples

```json
{
    "vase": "fancy",
    "nested": {
        "omega": "bar",
        "alpha": "foo"
    }
}
```

## Options

### `sortOrder`

Selects `natural` or `lexicographic` ordering. Natural ordering compares numbers by value
and is the default. Lexicographic ordering compares keys character by character.

The following configuration uses natural order:

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"assist": {
		"actions": {
			"source": {
				"useSortedKeys": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"sortOrder": "natural"
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

```json
{
    "val13": 1,
    "val1": 1,
    "val2": 1,
    "val21": 1,
    "val11": 1
}
```

The following configuration uses lexicographic order.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"assist": {
		"actions": {
			"source": {
				"useSortedKeys": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"sortOrder": "lexicographic"
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

```json
{
    "val13": 1,
    "val1": 1,
    "val2": 1,
    "val21": 1,
    "val11": 1
}
```

### `groupByNesting`

Groups keys by the shape of their values before sorting by name. Strings, numbers, booleans,
`null`, and single-line arrays or objects come first. Multi-line arrays and objects come
afterward. Defaults to `false`.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"assist": {
		"actions": {
			"source": {
				"useSortedKeys": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"groupByNesting": true
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

```json
{
    "name": "Sample",
    "details": {
        "description": "nested"
    },
    "id": 123
}
```
